text:
lee: Dropping the authn postmortem link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2369998888. Need to convert findings into owned actions with realistic ETAs and a weekly drift check. Please claim items you can deliver and add a short verification step.

tasha: I can take the permissions matrix cleanup (roles that gained broad perms during emergency fix). Plan: inventory, remove unnecessary binds, add an integration test to catch regressions. ETA: 2026-04-06.

devin: I'll own token TTL harmonization across services (we saw mismatched TTLs causing stale caches + weird errors during DST). I'll add unit tests and a runtime check that fails CI if TTLs diverge by >10s. ETA: 2026-04-02.

marco: I'll pick up the audit pipeline backfill. Two parts: 1) re-ingest missing Authenticate events from the buffer for last 72h, 2) add a schema validation stage so malformed payloads are dropped to dead-letter with alert. ETA for backfill: 2026-03-30. Schema validator in infra PR by 2026-04-03.

lee: Good. Can everyone add a 1-line smoke verification we can paste into the runbook so on-call can confirm changes after deploy? Keep to 1-2 commands.

tasha: Runbook smoke:
```
# verify no broad-role binds for svc-* namespaces
kubectl get rolebinding -A -o json | jq '.items[] | select(.subjects[]?.name | test("svc-")) | {name: .metadata.name, role: .roleRef.name}' | grep -v "limited-access"
```

devin: TTL smoke:
```
# check configured TTLs across services
curl -s https://config.redwood.internal/ttl | jq .services | sed -n '1,80p'
# run quick unit test
pytest tests/unit/test_ttl_consistency.py -q
```

marco: Audit backfill command (staging snippet):
```
# reingest missing Authenticate events from GCS buffer
python tools/audit_reingest.py --start="2026-03-27T00:00:00Z" --end="2026-03-29T23:59:59Z" --target=staging
# check saved query
SELECT * FROM audit WHERE protoPayload.methodName="Authenticate" AND jsonPayload.requestId IS NOT NULL ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 50
```

ops-bot: Created ticket SEC-1217: "AuthN follow-ups & remediation ownership". Claimed: permissions-cleanup (tasha), ttl-harmonize (devin), audit-backfill (marco). Added recurrence: weekly drift check (cron: 0 9 * * 1). Link: https://tracker.redwood/SEC-1217

lee: Consolidated closure checklist below. Update SEC-1217 as you make progress. We'll review the ticket in next security sync. If blockers appear, flag in #eng-oncall and cc me.

```
- [ ] Permissions matrix cleanup & integration test — owner: tasha — due: 2026-04-06
- [ ] Token TTL harmonization + CI guard — owner: devin — due: 2026-04-02
- [ ] Audit pipeline backfill + schema validator — owner: marco — due: 2026-03-30 (backfill) / 2026-04-03 (validator)
- [ ] Runbook smoke snippets added — owners: tasha/devin/marco — due: 2026-03-29
- [ ] Weekly drift monitor (alert if token TTL drift >10s, missing Authenticate events) — owner: ops-bot (SRE) — recurring weekly
```

tasha: Acked. I'll start the inventory tomorrow and link the PR in SEC-1217.

devin: Putting TTL CI guard in a draft PR now. Will ping for review once tests pass.

marco: Starting backfill in a small window on staging, will escalate if buffer replay hits more than 10% errors.

lee: Note on recurring pattern: this postmortem flagged a repeating issue around token expiry around clock changes/rollouts. Ops, please ensure drift checks consider timezone flips.

ops-bot: Scheduled SEC-1217-review: 2026-04-08 16:00 UTC. Added reminder 24h before. :calendar:
